state.scope: Advisory task triage only. Stages4/5 open. One exposed whole-organism 2s trajectory failed navigation: bearing error19.414deg after wind to27.558deg final. Six-foot traction device, no natural gait. Frozen forward0.2mm/s and alternating yaw; no gain tuning. Body replay400ms previously costs10.5s; new brain2s costs~6853s. Proposed bounded diagnostic: same prepared state, reproduce full2s identity; then remove wind, or postwind yaw, or postwind forward. Recorded commands held fixed, no CNS, cannot claim neural feedback. Max4 body replays,600sCPU, no organism. Jev does not decide scientific truth.

priority.instructions: Choose the action with most useful near-term information per cost for the stated failed navigation. Do not treat a route as scientifically proven.

criteria.A_physical_decomposition: Run the preregistered identity and three body-only ablations; isolate effects of delivered commands, tonic translation and physical wind before new CNS trials.
criteria.B_vnc_signal: Develop independent CNS-VNC-MN signal test first; adds interface uncertainty and requires anatomy/prior controls but could improve future motor authority.
criteria.C_full_gait: Integrate all six muscles/legs now; potentially more biological body but high confounding and cost while navigation remains failed.

review_risk.instructions: Pick the most important interpretation error for ChatGPT to challenge in the physical replay diagnostic.

criteria.neural_feedback: Calling same-command body replay evidence of neural corrective feedback or predicting CNS response to a changed trajectory.
criteria.raw_distance: Calling reduced source distance sufficient proof of orientation.
criteria.gait: Calling six contact rollers a coordinated biological gait.
